(rule!
  ;; alt: equivalent `for*/fold` over zero centers, but `cellmap` exposes the
  ;; local 3x3-ring predicate directly.
  (cellmap g (r c v)
    (let ((nbrs (neighbors-8 g r c 0)))
      (if (and (zero? v)
               (!= (first nbrs) 0)
               (all? (lambda (n) (= n (first nbrs))) nbrs))
          (first nbrs)
          v))))
